# SETTINGS3: a calm, premium Settings (design only)

**Owner (2026-11-15):** "I want to take a run at the polish pass once more. Especially the settings page. That is a
VERY long list of options and there has to be a good way to organize it all, have all the options but neat and tidy,
clean, just feels like a premium harness when you go into there."

**Today** (`SETTINGS3-inventory.md`, generated by `node scripts/settings3-inventory.mjs --write`): 83 pages, 82 of
them in one flat nav under 9 headings, 692 settings in the page markup (881 with the settings-like dialogs). Before
shots (`outputs/settings3/before/`): the nav is one list about 3,300 px tall; every select is full width (≈930 px
for "Provider");
labels sit above controls with large `?` circles; each page opens with a "How do I…?" box; search lists *pages*
("voice" ranks Business details 3rd, via "invoice"). 11 thin pages overlap a stronger one (inventory → Overlaps).

## The structure: 6 groups + Household, 51 nav entries instead of 82

| Group (nav entries) | Pages | What moves |
|---|---|---|
| **Sara** (9) — her name, follows a rename | Name and personality, Relationship, Look, Pictures from her, Voice, Hey Sara, Calls from her, Companions, At work | *Bring her from another app* → Move in and export |
| **You** (8) | About you, Appearance, **Briefing and reminders**, Automations, My details, Business details, What Sara knows, Adult mode | Leave-by reminders + When it comes up become sections of Briefing |
| **Models & usage** (5) | Default model, Which model does what, **Providers and plans**, On this computer, Usage and costs | Subscriptions → Providers; Budgets → Usage and costs › Limits |
| **Connections** (5) | **Apps and services** (new hub), Devices and sign-in, Phone and notifications, This computer, Computer use | 9 chat apps, Email and calendar (+ Gmail), Home Assistant, Spotify, GitHub, Web search, Data sources, Other apps, Other agents, Webhooks, Pick up across apps (+ Session continuity) become **tiles**; iPhone Shortcuts → section of Phone |
| **Skills & tools** (10) | Get more, Skills, Plugins, Other programs (MCP), Tools and approvals, Library, *Coding:* Coding projects, Check her edits, Keep going and repeats, Servers over SSH | Coding is a sub-heading, not a group |
| **Privacy & system** (7) | Safety check-up, Privacy, Backups, **Move in and export**, Health, Updates, Reports | How she did, Readiness and recovery, Operations → sections of Health; Move in from another agent + Bring her → Move in and export |
| **Household** (7; members see Your account, Usage reports, Shared links) | People on this server, Policy, Audit trail, Retention and legal hold, Trust report, Usage reports, Shared links | — |

**Every option stays reachable** and **no page id changes.** A merged page keeps its `<section data-page>` (and
its tips, tours, How-do-I answers) with a new `data-host="<page>"`: `showSettingsTab('you-leave-by')` opens Briefing
and reminders scrolled to that section, breadcrumbs say where it lives. Tile pages keep their ids too
(`#view=settings:co-telegram` opens the hub with Telegram's panel). Merges only join pages with the same audience
(owner/member/demo flags), so no visibility rule moves inside a page. Old group names (Her, Chat apps, Add-ons,
Coding, Data & health) are search words for one release, saying where things went (as `SETTINGS_WAS` does now).

## The ideas, decided
- **Fewer groups — yes (6 + Household).** Names say what is inside; "Data & health" and "Add-ons" were the hardest to guess.
- **Home as a calm overview — yes.** Sara's status (model, health, backups, version), *Needs your attention* (from the
  safety check-up, readiness and update checks; hidden when empty), 6 quick settings that drive the real controls
  (Night or Day, morning briefing, instant notifications, let her call me, Hey Sara, tidy long chats), connected apps
  with status dots, Household, then all groups with every page one click away (the V3 "≤ 2 clicks" rule holds).
- **Merge thin pages into sections — yes, 11 of them** (above). Pages stay pages when they have their own audience or job.
- **Advanced fold per page — yes, closed by default, remembered per device.** On ~20 long pages (Voice, Telegram,
  Discord, Phone, Default model, Policy, Keep going, Computer use, Coding projects…). A search hit inside opens it.
  No global "show advanced" switch (it hides things people then can't find).
- **One row anatomy — yes.** Label + one-line description left, control right-aligned at a fixed 232 px, a quiet `i`
  tip after the label (full strength on hover/focus); rows grouped in cards with one radius, one padding, hairlines.
  Long pages get an *On this page* list at ≥ 1280 px.
- **Connections as tiles + detail panel — yes.** Status dot + one line per tile ("Connected · @alex", "Can't sign in").
  The panel slides over the grid on desktop and is a full page on phones; it hosts the page's existing section.
- **Search as the hero — yes.** Ctrl K in Settings (and "Find a setting" in the global palette) opens a palette:
  *Best match* page, then **settings** (label, path, current value), then pages; Enter opens the page, unfolds Advanced
  if needed and highlights the row for 2 s. Same index as today for page ranking, plus one record per control.
- **Sticky header with save state — yes.** "All changes saved" / "Saved" chip replaces the footer note; Save buttons
  stay only for secrets and multi-field forms (keys, providers, invites), as today.
- **Phone (390) as a drill-down — yes.** Settings → group → page, a back label in the sticky top bar, search on top,
  field rows stack (label, then a full-width control), switches stay inline.
- **Look:** theme variables only (`web/theme.css`, light and dark), new layout tokens next to the V1 ones, accent only
  for switches, focus and the current item; status dots are the only other colours. Sara Classic keeps its look.

## Tests that encode today's structure, and the change
`test/ui-cleanup.test.ts` (83 pages stays: the hub and home are not `settings-page`s; co-continuity/dh-operations group
names change) · `test/phase128b.test.ts` 128b.1 (group list, per-group "want" lists, caps → "≤ 10 nav entries per
group", one run per group) and 128b.8 (guide index by group) · `test/v3-design.test.ts` slice 2 (homeModel order,
crumbs gain *Apps and services* for tiles, every page linked from home) · `test/phase114d.test.ts` (guide headings in
the new order) · `test/phase128d.test.ts` 128d.7 (`SETTINGS_WAS` gains the 5 old names) · `test/phase114c.test.ts` and
`test/v2-design.test.ts` (accordion / flat-nav markup → the two-level rail) · `test/ec28-ui.test.ts`,
`test/ec3-ui.test.ts`, `test/phase96.test.ts` (`data-group` of dh-recovery, dh-operations, ab-skills) ·
`test/automations.test.ts`, `test/devices-findable.test.ts`, `test/r4-iphone.test.ts` (order substrings).
Must stay green unchanged: `test/help.test.ts` + `scripts/tip-coverage.ts` (merged sections stay sibling `<section>`s,
never nested: its lazy `</section>` match), `test/q2-ui.test.ts`, `test/ezplain.test.ts`, 128b.3 (page ranking),
`test/settings-instant.test.ts` (autosave), `test/q4-ui.test.ts` (`settingsPages()` filter), `test/web-static.test.ts`.

## Slices (each ships alone; sizes are new/changed lines)
| Slice | What | Size | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Row anatomy, cards, sticky header + save chip (CSS in `web/settings3.css`, scoped outside Classic; no markup moves) | ~350 | every page shot light/dark × 1440/390 (contact sheets), scoping test |
| S2 | 6 groups, two-level rail, merges via `data-host`, renames, `SETTINGS_WAS`, guide/HOW_DO_I regenerated, i18n ×5 | ~450 + 90 attributes | updated tests above; every old id opens the right section |
| S3 | Advanced folds on ~20 pages; search/jump opens them | ~200 | tip-coverage 0, fold test |
| S4 | Search palette with setting-level results, jump + highlight | ~330 | 128b.3 unchanged + new "every label finds its row" test |
| S5 | Connections hub: tiles, status model from existing endpoints, panel | ~500 | every tile page reachable; fixture statuses |
| S6 | Home overview: status, Needs attention, quick settings, apps, household | ~420 | quick toggles change the real inputs (autosave fires once) |
| S7 | Phone drill-down polish and a full screenshot sweep | ~180 | 390 shots, a11y checker (`web/a11y-check.js`) |

About 2,400 lines plus ~600 lines of tests. Risks: CSS fights with `ui-tidy.css`/`v4-pages.css` (S1 sweeps every
page); translations (~40 new strings); tip-coverage lookback around new wrappers; quick settings must proxy the real
inputs so there is one source of truth.

## Questions for the owner
1. **Coding** as a sub-heading inside *Skills & tools* (6 groups) or its own group (7)? *Recommend: sub-heading*;
   coders find it by name in the rail and by search.
2. Name the first group after her (**"Sara"**, or "Fred" after a rename) instead of "Her"? *Recommend: yes.*
3. Sara Classic: new structure with the Classic look, or the old nav kept? *Recommend: new structure for everyone*,
   one nav to maintain.

states and numbers on it are examples), shots `outputs/settings3/mock-*.png`, before `outputs/settings3/before/`.
